title: A blizzard cut my power. Someone outside is shoveling a circle around my house.
story:
Scrape. Pause. Scrape. Someone was shoveling outside my bedroom window at two in the morning, in the middle of a blizzard.

The power had been out since dinner. And I live alone at the end of a dead-end road, with nothing behind me but woods.

All evening, the drifts outside had stayed smooth and white. Not one track anywhere.

I shined my flashlight down. There was a fresh trench in the snow, dug clean along the side of the house. Nobody was holding a shovel. But I could still hear it, scraping around the corner toward the back door.

I followed the sound from window to window. The trench was going all the way around. A circle, with my house in the middle.

The snow by the woods wasn't smooth anymore. It was covered in tracks. Hundreds of them, all coming toward the house, all stopping right at the edge of the trench.

A tired voice drifted up through the wind. "Stay inside the line."

The scraping slowed near the back door. Then it stopped. The circle was one step short of closing. So I ran downstairs and opened the back door to finish it.

The tracks were already on my porch.
premise: in a blizzard power outage, an unseen shoveler digs a protective circle around the house; tracks from the woods stop at the trench, but the circle is left open at the back door
